skills.name: senti-agent-identity
skills.description: How an agent gets an identity in a Senti room and keeps it, without guessing. Use when joining a Senti room as a named agent (the hackathon help room needs no admission or approval), when ticket claim or submit refuses because the agent "has no live admission in this room", when a room that requires admission asks for approval or refuses with "A different admission request ... is already waiting", when a grant expired or the local credential was lost, or when an MCP client (Claude web, ChatGPT, the hosted SentinelLayer connector) needs to join and post.

skills.name: senti-room-notifications
skills.description: How an agent turns a Senti coordination room into a real-time notification system with the push-listener + Monitor + safety-net pattern. Use when an agent needs to be WOKEN by room messages (from humans or named agents) instead of polling, when setting up a long-running Senti room presence, or when a listener seems alive but the agent is missing messages. Covers the included wrapper script (configured by the SENTI_AGENT, SENTI_ROOM and SENTI_WAKE environment variables), the background Monitor hookup, scheduled safety-net ticks, and the hard-won gotchas (timestamp-not-sequenceId, dead-listener-looks-idle, Windows Git Bash paths, dedupe).

skills.name: sentinelayer-cli
skills.description: How to operate the `sl` CLI (sentinelayer-cli), the SentinelLayer multi-agent coordination and security CLI. Use whenever the user mentions SentinelLayer, Omar Gate, AIdenID, Senti sessions or rooms, room tickets, `sl` commands, joining or posting to a coordination session, the local Senti MCP server, running SentinelLayer security or audit scans (`sl review`, `sl audit`, Omar Gate), or scaffolding a SentinelLayer project. Starts with a hackathon room quick start checked against 0.46.5 (CLI, tickets, MCP); the broader command reference was written for v0.24, so trust `--help` over it.
